featured_reviews.name: Kabir Kabir
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to Janta Garage, Mira Road to fix a noise coming from the front left wheel area of my Honda WRV. I was told the issue would be resolved after servicing.

I ended up spending more than ₹10,000, but after the service, the same noise was still there. When I went back and questioned them, I was told that “another part needs to be replaced” and they did not have that part earlier.

This raises a serious question:

If the actual faulty part was not replaced, WHY did I pay ₹10k in the first place?

The original cost should have been around ₹6,000, but it suddenly went up to ₹10,000+ without proper explanation. It honestly felt like a complete scam.

Important Warning to Customers:
•	Always ask for the old spare parts to be returned
•	Don’t trust blindly if you are not standing there while work is being done
•	Get a clear written estimate before approving any work

In my case, I trusted them and ended up wasting money with no solution. This garage is NOT transparent, and I would not recommend Janta Garage, Mira Road to anyone looking for honest or reliable car repair.

It’s better to find a trustworthy mechanic who explains the issue clearly and doesn’t overcharge.
